source_caption:
🎬 With Honors (1994)

With Honors follows Monty Kessler, an ambitious Harvard University student who believes that academic success and graduating with honors are the keys to building a successful future. His carefully planned life takes an unexpected turn when his only copy of his senior thesis falls through a basement grate and ends up in the hands of Simon Wilder, a homeless man living beneath the university’s library. Desperate to recover his work, Monty discovers that Simon refuses to return the thesis unless Monty agrees to provide him with food, shelter, and other necessities in exchange for each page. What begins as a frustrating arrangement slowly develops into an unlikely friendship that challenges everything Monty believes about intelligence, achievement, and personal success. As Simon becomes involved in Monty’s life and meets his college roommates, his sharp wit, unconventional wisdom, and surprising knowledge begin to influence the entire group. Through humorous encounters, emotional conversations, and unexpected revelations, Monty discovers that some of life’s most valuable lessons cannot be learned inside a classroom. As their friendship deepens, Simon’s personal struggles reveal the importance of compassion, dignity, and human connection. Combining heartfelt drama, gentle comedy, and meaningful storytelling, the film explores friendship, kindness, education, personal growth, and the true meaning of success.

🎭 Genre: Comedy • Drama

⭐ IMDb: 6.7/10

⏱️ Runtime: 1h 43m • PG-13

🎥 Director: Alek Keshishian

source_details.synopsis: With Honors is a 1994 American comedy-drama film directed by Alek Keshishian. It stars Brendan Fraser as a Harvard University student who finds himself at the mercy of the demands of a homeless man (Joe Pesci) when he holds his senior thesis paper hostage. Moira Kelly, Patrick Dempsey, Josh Hamilton, and Gore Vidal also star. The film was released on April 29, 1994, received generally negative reviews from critics, and grossed $20 million.
